title: About the Collection platform
paragraph1: Welcome to the Collection Platform of the National Collection for Architecture and Urban Planning, managed by the Nieuwe Instituut. Here, we invite you to wander through a treasure trove of archives, objects, people, and publications. Click through, explore, and discover the rich history and diverse heritage of Dutch architecture and urban planning. Whether you are an enthusiast, student, or professional, our platform offers an inspiring journey through the past, present, and future. Be surprised by the most unexpected finds from the collection.
paragraph2: The collection is physically and digitally accessible to everyone: students, curators, architects, scientists, educational institutions, restorers, and anyone else with an interest in the built environment. The diversity of the collection and the combination of archives and library make it possible to conduct extensive research into the lives and works of architects, their connections with each other, and their contributions to and work for various organizations. Additionally, the collection plays a central role in the research and exhibition program of the Nieuwe Instituut.
